verdict.rationale: A payments platform with configurable logic, such as fraud rules and webhooks, could plausibly offer versioning and rollback, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents versioning, review, or rollback of automations or rules. The custom fraud-logic and webhook items describe adjacent features, not change history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
